mapper.select: SELECT l.*, u.username, u.real_name FROM Log l LEFT JOIN User u ON l.user_id = u.user_id WHERE l.log_id = #{logId}
SELECT l.*, u.username, u.real_name FROM Log l LEFT JOIN User u ON l.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY l.operation_time DESC
SELECT l.*, u.username, u.real_name FROM Log l LEFT JOIN User u ON l.user_id = u.user_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY l.operation_time DESC
SELECT l.*, u.username, u.real_name FROM Log l LEFT JOIN User u ON l.user_id = u.user_id WHERE l.operation_type = #{operationType} ORDER BY l.operation_time DESC
SELECT l.*, u.username, u.real_name FROM Log l LEFT JOIN User u ON l.user_id = u.user_id WHERE l.operation_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY l.operation_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Log(user_id, operation_type, operation_content, operation_time) VALUES(#{userId}, #{operationType}, #{operationContent}, #{operationTime} NOW())
